# Meta Improvement Loop Dashboard

> Second-order repository control. Measures RIL telemetry and tunes bounded process surfaces without weakening evidence guardrails.

Frozen first checkpoint:
- completed RIL cycles: 4
- median total cycle: 631.5 s
- median observation -> first change: 488.0 s
- median last change -> verification: 41.5 s
- median verification -> promotion: 32.5 s
- verified-before-promotion ratio: 1.0

First triggered signals:
- diagnosis_dominates
- rework_signal

First tuning:
- Critic Router v1
- source-proximate preflight
- full promotion gates remain required

Evaluation:
- require >=3 post-tuning RIL cycles before claiming improvement
- target observation -> first change median below 488 s
- preserve verification-before-promotion ratio 1.0
- observer footprint must stay under soft design warnings

Recursion:
- automatic control depth = 2
- no automatic third-order controller
